searchText: Are there tests for el triggered withdrawal requests in assertoor? I didnt see any in pectra-dev folder It's the same operation as el triggered exits. We trigger such an exit, modifiying it to a partial withdrawal should be easy 🙂 to trigger a successful partial withdrawal we'll need a more complex setup first. Like a validator with > 32 ETH and 0x02 creds set.
